# qrcode-generator (vendored)

- What: `qrcode.js` from the npm package `qrcode-generator` 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase (http://www.d-project.com/).
- Licence: MIT. The package ships no LICENSE file; the licence is named in the header of `qrcode.js`, and `LICENSE` here is the standard MIT text with that copyright line.
- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-1.4.4.tgz, tarball sha1 `63f771224854759329a99048806a53ed278740e7` (equals the registry's published shasum). `qrcode.js` is the file from the tarball, byte for byte (56694 bytes).
- Used by: `sun-wall.html` when the link says `?qr=1` (level 2 of "Print this Sun"). Nothing else loads it. The wall works without it.
- "QR Code" is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.
- Do not edit `qrcode.js`; replace it with a newer upstream file and update this note.
